_note: Single source of truth for every weight, penalty and taxonomy entry. Scores change only if this file changes. Values marked 'assumed' were not stated in the architecture document and should be confirmed by the committee.

sentiment.insufficient_note: Below the minimum evidence standard sentiment reports Insufficient Data rather than a forced +1 or 0 (Reconciliation fix 6).
sentiment.aggregation_note: Anchored at 0: a 0 label is no signal and neither adds nor subtracts. Every non-zero event pulls in its direction with recency x confidence weight; the score is the net of all positives against all negatives (falls back to the all-event mean below min_signal_events). The two veto rules (plus_two_requires_no_results_offset, minus_one_when_results_negative) are OFF: the IC can switch them on if it decides results prints should override the net weighing.
sentiment.simple_note: v1.9.0 (simple and checkable by hand): stock sentiment = weighted average of the -2..+2 scores of EVERY article about the company (0s included), weight by window only - W1 0-30d 1.0, W2 31-90d 0.75, W3 91-180d 0.5, W4 181-365d 0.25; no source-confidence factor. Shown as points = average x 50 (-100..+100). Bands: >= +50 -> +2, +15..+49 -> +1, -14..+14 -> 0, -15..-49 -> -1, <= -50 -> -2. Not counted: passing mentions, share-price-only items, governance-search articles (they feed governance). window_weights replaces the half-life curve when present.
sentiment.recency_note: Weight = max(recency_floor, 0.5 ^ (age_trading_days / half_life_trading_days)). v1.7.0: half-life 90 trading days with a 0.15 floor (was 126 / 0.25, which left the last month with only ~24% of the weight). Weights by age: now 1.00, 1m 0.85, 3m 0.62, 6m 0.38, 9m 0.24, 12m 0.15 - the whole year still counts, but recent news leads. This is on top of the sampler's recency-tilted article budget.

band_cutoffs._note: v2.0.0: scores are banded directly on the -2..+2 mean (no points/x50 step). 0.5..1.59 -> +1 (e.g. mean 1.2 -> +1); >=1.6 -> +2 (needs stronger, more consistent evidence than a bare round-to-nearest would). Mirrored for -1/-2. Computed for BOTH the raw mean (plain average of every counted article's label score) and the weighted mean (recency x confidence weighted average) - shown side by side, never combined into one number.

age_taper._note: v1.7.0: a penalised event keeps its full penalty for 6 months, then tapers linearly to half by 12 months (penalty x factor, rounded to a whole point). Human-set weights on verified evidence are not tapered. Set end_factor 1.0 to switch off.

investigation: Unresolved probe active in the window.
pledge_invocation: Forced selling into the market - the classic mid/small-cap stress spiral.
pledge: Pledged % of promoter holding; penalised only at medium/high materiality.
insolvency_admission: Insolvency admission (IBC) / compulsory delisting / long suspension
Can go to near zero and may not be exitable.

Clean: No material adverse events in the 12-month window.
Watch: One or more disclosed items warranting monitoring; not integrity-level.
Flag: Live or recent event requiring IC-level attention before adding risk.

routine_types.management_change_routine: elevation, promotion, new appointment, planned retirement/succession, or an exit below CXO tier - not penalised
routine_types.rpt_routine: routine / approved / arm's-length related-party transaction - not penalised
routine_types.board_change_routine: ordinary board reconstitution or appointment with no independence gap - not penalised
routine_types.investigation_closed: probe concluded, quashed or cleared - not penalised (only a live probe is)
routine_types.auditor_rotation: scheduled auditor rotation / routine reappointment - not penalised
routine_types.lock_in_expiry: a scheduled lock-in expiry is a supply-overhang data point, not a governance penalty - tracked in Corporate Actions

conventions._note: Conventions from the 1-Oct-2026 Reconciliation (section 7, fixes 2-3). They were never written down before, so a second implementer could not follow them.

subject_never_penalised.victim: the company is the victim (e.g. a bank defrauded by borrowers/appraisers)
subject_never_penalised.lender_or_counterparty: the event is about a lender / counterparty / customer
subject_never_penalised.peer_or_sector: sector or peer news (e.g. industry-wide rule tightening)
subject_never_penalised.macro_policy: macro or fiscal policy (e.g. a customs-duty hike)
subject_never_penalised.shareholders: an event about shareholders, not the company (e.g. KYC non-compliant holders)

conventions.materiality_floor_note: Sums below Rs 10 crore (or 0.1% of revenue) sit in the procedural band unless the matter is integrity-type (SEBI conduct, fraud, auditor integrity).
conventions.notice_without_order_note: A notice or demand with no order is a live overhang (-10), not a -20 order/settlement.
conventions.dedupe_note: The same real-world event reported on several days / as several types is ONE event: keep the most severe penalty.
conventions.resolved_never_penalised: A matter resolved or quashed in the company's favour is not a live overhang.

corporate_actions.model: severity x stage x timing x size, capped at 10 per event; Risk and Opportunity combined separately as 1 - product(1 - event_score/10) (chance at least one bites), never summed or averaged

stage_multiplier._note: approval_obtained = shareholder or regulatory approval obtained; completed = record date fixed or passed

timing._note: ca_days_to_effective > 0 on the label -> upcoming bucket by that count; otherwise the event is past and decays by half every N days from the article's publish date (its own half-life above, else the default).

corporate_actions._size_note: ca_size_pct on the label (dilution %, pledged % of promoter holding, rights discount %) selects the band above; if the label has no ca_size_pct, materiality (low/medium/high) stands in; if neither applies to the event type (e.g. insolvency, demerger, auditor exit), the multiplier is 1.0 (no size scaling).
corporate_actions.direction_from_sentiment: label.sentiment > 0 -> positive (feeds Opportunity); < 0 -> negative (feeds Risk); 0 -> unclear (feeds Risk, as the table specifies 'negative or unclear')

gate_a_hard_exit._note: Straight to the Exit band regardless of the arithmetic. An auditor_resignation only triggers Gate A when the label's severity is 'integrity' (withheld-information / irregularity resignations, not a routine/explained exit).

gate_b_data_quarantine._note: These add nothing to the Risk score and are shown separately as quarantined - price/fundamentals need the adjustment-factor checks in the rules doc before model-driven signals on the stock resume.

disclosure_tracked_not_scored._note: Kept on the calendar and shown in the Corporate Actions sheet/section, but excluded from the Risk/Opportunity arithmetic - the rules doc treats these (and results announcements, already scored under sentiment) as disclosure events, not formal corporate actions.

corporate_actions.worked_example_check: QIP 6x0.6x1.0x1.2=4.3; pledge 7x1.0x1.0x0.7=4.9; CFO exit 6x1.0x0.8x1.0=4.8 -> chance nothing bites 0.57x0.51x0.52=0.15 -> Risk 8.5 -> Act (matches the rules doc's worked example)

dedupe.note: Repeat headlines of one declaration are ONE action (same event_type + same figures within the window).

sentiment_anchors: Sustained fundamental beats with broad confirming evidence (record earnings, upgraded guidance, favourable structural drivers) and no material offset in the lookback.
Positive year on balance, but with a specific offset — one weak quarter, an execution issue, or a valuation caution — that prevents the maximum score.
Genuinely two-sided: material positive drivers matched by material negative drivers, or coverage judged insufficient to score directionally.
Material earnings deterioration or a defined event whose economic impact dominates the year, even if partial offsets exist.

lint.note: Share-price moves never feed sentiment (Reconciliation fix 5). Price lives in the context overlay only.

universe.note: The universe is hashed and diffed against the last confirmed run; an unconfirmed change refuses to run (Reconciliation fix 4).

retrieval.note: Backdating a live search is not a point-in-time backtest (Reconciliation fix 1). Past as-of dates use the dated archive (GDELT) or are stamped 'live index, cut-off X'.
